rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a module file, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This module file is not the reference artefact the exercise builds.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 10: 'watch Laura Entis on Kieran Klaassen, [You're the Bread in the AI Sandwich]... read Kieran Klaassen, [Compound Engineering: The Definitive Guide]' (two namings) + line 136: 'Read, Kieran Klaassen, [My AI Had Already Fixed the Code Before I Saw It]' (third naming) — Klaassen named three times across Prework and Pre-reads-before-M6 in this one module file.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Either drop the name on one of the three citations (link text/title still carries the reference) or add an explicit maintainer-block carve-out per rule 11's 2026-08-02 spaced-repetition exception, naming which two placements do different jobs and why the third is load-bearing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No overreaching slogan/banner-question framing in this file that would need a downstream carve-out.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
Watch out for planting jargon too early.
Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
Past tense for exercise recap sections — heading and body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'What happened:'-shaped recap/Debrief section in this module file's scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bare 'M1'/'M4'/'M5' fine (file sits at M5, past the M2 earning threshold); 'compounding'/'the loop' are curriculum-wide terms earned long before M5.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 74/84: 'context' used for ambient runtime/scrollback state, matches the rule's definition; 'memory' not used loosely.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION; read to the boundary before cutting anything.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Coordinate-missing / rules-file-elsewhere recovery lines (lines 42, 56, 58) are plausible-failure, non-obvious, time-critical rescues (scrollback/SHA window) — fit the exception.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Fenced-prompt bodies ({{prompt:...}} placeholders) are not visible in this file to audit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module. Compound-shape varies per module — never repeat same Debrief.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No retro-interview Debrief content in this module file's scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Self-study simulation rule; not applicable to this in-person/synchronous module file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes
Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 78 names both `CLAUDE.md` and `CLAUDE.local.md` explicitly; line 109 uses `CLAUDE.local.md` specifically.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Action sections lead with verbs ('Set up the worktree', 'Run the fork...', 'Send it off and read the report cold', 'Bring the worktree's work home', 'Bring to Module 6'); non-action framing/reference sections ('The nag writes the verifier', 'Back to the map, one last time', 'Pre-reads before Module 6') use declarative headers, consistent with the lecture/reference carve-out.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No first-authored use of a contested word (memory/skill/plan/agent/subagent) introduced in this module file; all established in earlier modules.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 50 'Claude figures out `<repo-name>`... Help it if it gets confused.'; line 54 'Claude will narrate before acting.'; line 58 'Claude should read the protected `Run coordinates` block...'; line 92 'Claude lists the worktree root and reads what it finds.' — these describe autonomous acting behavior, which the rule's concrete split defaults to 'the agent', not 'Claude' (invocation lines like 'Ask Claude to...' at lines 56/94/109 are correctly Claude).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Swap the acting-behavior instances to 'the agent' ('the agent figures out...', 'the agent will narrate before acting...', 'the agent should read...', 'the agent lists the worktree root...'); keep 'Ask Claude to...' invocation lines as-is.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
No meta-ask when student has already decided.
`.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: reference.md / plan.md / CLAUDE.local.md / RUN-NOTES.md all consistent with the default; no competing extension used for a text artifact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The '## Next' preview names 'Module 6' as a doing-subject in canonical bridge-section register ('Module 6 reads the packaged run...'), not a value-prop/system-as-subject claim about the training itself; 'you' carries the rest of the closers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 24 blockquote 'Long runs, short reads' restates the M1 countermove at the M5 moment of use, matching the rule's intent.
